snippet.title: Sea Sniffers – Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3045520/Sea_Sniffers/
Dive! Punch! Catch! 🦭🐟
Sea Sniffers is a cozy fishing RPG with a twist- you play as a seal who throws a mean punch!

Explore the ocean, catch unique fish, and document over 100 species in this vibrant underwater adventure.

Sea Sniffers is coming to Steam in 2027!

Wishlist now 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3045520/Sea_Sniffers/
